about: One row per function (where it runs, which game hook calls it, whether it can be called over the network) and one per config hook into Arma 3.

rows.about: Generated: every sheet row as a hashmap (one struct per row).
Shared clock: serverTime in multiplayer, time in single player.
Distance along the track -> [position ATL, direction].
Shortest ground distance from a spot to the track's centre line (build spacing).
How far a bloon has travelled now, from [type,d0,t0,mult,until,hp] (handles slow/freeze).
Turns the maps row into the track polyline (ATL points, cumulative lengths).
Mission entry: picks the map row, starts server and player parts.
Server: track, hidden clutter, shared state, the server loop.
Server loop step: spawn schedule, leaks, tower shots, round end.
Server: adds one bloon at a track distance, queued for the next client batch.
Server: pops layers, releases children with leftover damage, pays cash, honours lead and MOAB rules.
Server: re-bases a bloon onto a slow or freeze.
Server: one tower picks the first bloon in range and hits it with its row's numbers.
A tower's row merged with its upgrade, if bought.
Server: spawns the Arma object and crew, or the BTD6 pad.
Client->server: build a tower (checks cash, track and tower spacing).
Client->server: buy a tower's upgrade.
Client->server: sell a tower.
Client->server: start the next round.
Client->server: toggle fast forward.
Client->server on join: send the live bloons to that client.
Client->server: a player's bullet crossed a bloon.
Client->server: a player's grenade or rocket exploded.
Server: sends this tick's spawns, pops, slows and shot effects to every client in one message.
Server: ends the game (win or loss) for everyone.
Server->clients: apply spawns, pops, slows and draw shot effects.
Server->joining client: full list of live bloons.
Server->clients: end screen.
Server->clients: short message on screen.
Client: invincible, glide, actions, HUD, draw and shot handlers.
Client: hover-glide movement for the player.
Client: draws bloons, BTD6 monkeys, range ring and shot effects as billboards.
Client: follows the player's bullets and grenades for pops.
Client: moves followed bullets and tests them against bloons.
Client: Cash / Lives / Round bar.
Client: opens the build tablet dialog.
Client: tablet button -> build at the spot you look at.
Client: the tower within 6 m of the player.
Client: upgrade / sell actions for the nearest tower, kept up to date.
Client: BTD6 picture from the converted art pack if present, else the stand-in.
Client: plays a sounds-sheet effect at a position.
Self Test scenario: builds every tower, plays all rounds fast, checks glide, writes PASS/FAIL to the RPT log.

config_hooks.about: Function library: every function row above.
Only rows with net server/clients may be called over the network.
Build tablet dialog: one button per towers row, ARMA and BTD6 columns.
Red PLAY BTD OPS button on the main menu (solo mission).
Solo, Co-op 1-4 and Self Test scenarios.

verify.RscDisplayMain: The red PLAY BLOON STRIKE button shows on Arma 3's main menu and playMission starts the solo scenario from the addon path.
verify.glideTick: In the running game: the player hovers with the gun up (no falling animation). The Self Test logs the animations it saw.
verify.draw3D: Billboards draw through hills and buildings (drawIcon3D has no depth test); judge in game whether that needs hiding behind terrain.
verify.btd6_converter: On a real BTD6 install: which sprite names it finds (btdops_art_pictures.txt) and that Arma shows the converted PAAs.
verify.coop: Host and join with two PCs: towers, bloons and cash stay in step for the joiner.
